items.question: Which maternal ancestors are to be worshipped among the pitṛs?
premises: maternal grandfathers and others are also pitṛs
maternal grandmothers and others are also pitṛs
the worshipped ancestor list includes both maternal sides
items.inference: maternal ancestors of both genders are included among the worshipped pitṛs
uncertainties: the exact scope of ādi is not specified
items.plain_english: Maternal grandfathers and others, and maternal grandmothers and others too, are also [to be worshipped].
